meta.name: shinka-inspect
meta.description: Load top-performing Shinka programs into agent context using `shinka.utils.load_programs_to_df`, and emit a compact Markdown bundle for iteration planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 加载 Shinka 程序到上下文并生成迭代计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在开发或优化 Shinka 程序，需要快速回顾和规划迭代。
copy.tagline_en: Load Shinka programs into context and generate iteration plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing or optimizing Shinka programs and need quick review and iteration planning.

howto.what: 它从Shinka运行结果目录中读取程序记录，按综合得分排序选出前k个正确程序，打包成包含元数据、排名、反馈和代码片段的Markdown文件，供后续迭代参考。
howto.when: 当你有Shinka运行的结果目录和SQLite数据库，并想检查顶级程序时触发。

say.text: 读取我的Shinka运行结果，显示前5个最佳程序。
帮我检查运行目录，输出前8个程序，代码截断5000字符。
say.note: 可调整k值和代码长度参数。

say.text: 忽略前10代，从第11代开始选取顶级程序。

howto.what_en: It loads program records from a Shinka run results directory, ranks them by combined_score, selects the top-k correct programs, and writes a compact Markdown bundle with metadata, ranking table, feedback, and code snippets for iteration planning.
howto.when_en: Use this skill when a Shinka run has produced a results directory and SQLite database, and you want to inspect top-performing programs before the next batch.

say_en.text: Read my Shinka run results and show the top 5 best programs.
Inspect the run directory and output top 8 programs with code truncated to 5000 chars.
Ignore the first 10 generations and select top programs from generation 11 onward.
